scope: Combine existing independent left/right Shift and Ctrl held bits for text/status translation.

implementation.source_of_truth: Shift reads existing physical HID held bits e1/e5; Ctrl reads e0/e4. Remove duplicate merged private bools and make/break assignments.
implementation.release_and_repeat: Each physical release clears only its own existing bit. Duplicate makes retain a boolean, never increment a hold count. Extended right Ctrl keeps its E0 identity.
implementation.reset: Existing physical clear/confirmed resync already clears both sides before text/status reset; getters therefore report released. Alt/AltGr, codepoint controls, public snapshots and metadata/sequence/wake ownership stay unchanged.
implementation.diagnostic: Existing CHECK INPUT /MODIFIERS /OVERLAP reuses the phase and QMP helpers for both release orders of Shift and Ctrl. Each case checks remaining-side physical mask, character/control code, complete release and final key-up. Host requests duplicate makes and records actual guest repeat flags.

validation.comparison_limit: One final STANDARD per subversion; score changes are descriptive single-run observations.

comparison_previous_release.observation: Overall stays close to0.84.8, while scheduler/memory/filesystem scores decrease and IPC increases strongly. These different single-run movements are retained without assigning causality to input changes or claiming repeatability; no extra benchmark or method change.

performance_assessment: Normal input decode/status paths change; exactly one final Suite-2 STANDARD on SMP4 is required.
limits: The explicit mode requires the standalone boot terminal without a competing desktop physical consumer.
Four overlap cases are the new affected scope; previously passed timed holds/resync and unrelated input catalogs are not repeated.
QMP requests alone do not prove repeated-make delivery; actual physical FLAG_REPEAT observations are recorded separately.
Emulated PS/2 only; physical keyboard hardware and a Windows host are not exercised.
Full benchmark exports and raw samples remain outside Git.
